name: Seduce Me: My Princess
source:
"My beautiful princess... I am yours forever..."

Erik and I have been living the perfect fairy tale and I couldn't be happier of the fact. However, something still intrigues me...

What was life like for Erik as a noble?

[From [url=https://vamichaelalaws.itch.io/seduce-me-the-otome-episode-series]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我美丽的公主……我永远属于你……”

埃里克和我一直生活在完美的童话故事中，对此我感到无比高兴。然而，有件事仍然让我着迷……

埃里克作为贵族的生活是什么样的？
